name: town-yard-broken
notes: The yard before room 6: one scale, broken, so it never reads as two.

slots.reference: Edit image 1. Keep everything exactly as it is: the same composition, camera angle, buildings, ground, scale and drawing style. Change only what follows.
slots.subject: The long brass balance beam is broken and has fallen: one end has dropped so it hangs steeply tilted, one of its chains snapped and lying on the ground. The platform is empty: no crate on it. The pan in the middle is empty and hangs crooked, with no weights in it.
